info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Telecom Sim Esim Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM and eSIM Status Retrieval API provides real-time access to the status of both physical SIM cards and eSIMs offered by telecom providers. This endpoint allows consumers, such as application developers and telecom management platforms, to fetch detailed status information, which is vital for troubleshooting and service management. Typical use cases include monitoring SIM and eSIM availability and managing customer subscriptions. The API ensures seamless integration with existing systems, enabling efficient telecom service operations.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of the eSIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current status of the eSIM. It provides insights into whether the eSIM is activated, suspended, or if there are any issues that need to be addressed.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of the eSIM. This request does not include any parameters and expects a response detailing the eSIM status.

204.description: Request successfully processed with no content returned.

ListTelecomSimEsimStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to eSIM status. It is a plain string that may be utilized for conveying specific parameters or identifiers related to the eSIM status request.
